original_request: Ensure Google, Naver, and Kakao first-install login always keeps the required three-page tutorial until final confirmation, and Google account-picker back/cancel clears the pending login/loading so other login methods can be used again. Apply to iOS and Android shared code.
interpreted_requirements: All three social providers use the same required first-install feature tour and it cannot be dismissed before final confirmation.
Do not force-navigate home after an OAuth callback when the router or Shell has already moved to an in-app route or opened the required tour.
Google OAuth cancel/back releases login loading and permits retry/provider switching.
Cancel only the matching login-purpose attempt; preserve Naver calendar link, email confirmation, password recovery, PKCE, and late valid success callbacks.
Use shared Flutter code for both iOS and Android; no native/provider/store configuration change and no deployment.
non_requirements: No provider-specific copies of the tutorial.
No force sign-out when a chooser is canceled.
No deployment or release metadata change.

authority.initial_selection: Planner and Integrator selected high_risk because OAuth/authentication async state is involved.
authority.dispatch: Required Complex Implementer and High-risk Escalation roles dispatched.

Explorer.assignment: Inspect source, routes, tasks, and tests read-only.
Explorer.evidence: OAuthCallbackHandler._syncAndRouteHome signs in then unconditionally go(home); required tour is subsequently pushed from Shell. LoginScreen retains spinner after launch and only resumes delayed session check; no cancel/resume test exists.

Planner.assignment: Plan scoped shared auth/onboarding fix and verification.
Planner.evidence: Keep required three-page tour provider-independent; scope cancellation to login attempt, preserve optional tour and calendar/email pending states, test retries/callback routing and iOS/Android shared paths.

High-risk Escalation.assignment: Read-only auth race/late callback review before implementation.
High-risk Escalation.evidence: Flagged unconditional go(home) as probable tutorial dismissal race; recommended attempt identity/bounded cancellation, login-only pending cleanup, preserve PKCE and avoid force signOut.

Complex Implementer.assignment: Implement shared OAuth cancellation scoping and preserve required tutorial navigation; add targeted regression tests.
Complex Implementer.evidence: Added explicit cancel, 900ms resume/session resolution, revision-scoped cleanup with same-provider duplicate-mark idempotency, async persistence revision guards, and removed forced home navigation. Focused tests: login screen 7 PASS; OAuth handler + shell onboarding order 19 PASS; git diff --check PASS. No commit/deploy.

Reviewer.assignment: Independently review final diff, callback cancellation race, and tutorial routing coverage.
Reviewer.evidence: No BLOCKER/HIGH. Revision-scoped callback errors and login-screen matching prevent an old-revision error from clearing a newer login spinner; cancel/retry widget regression test covers it. MEDIUM remains: no end-to-end OAuth callback→router→required-tour integration/widget test; current source-contract test plus isolated tour/Shell tests do not prove the integrated route. Implementer confirmed production appRouter/AuthProvider/AppEnv are global, protected routes require resolved Supabase session, and Shell starts OS services/timers; a reliable integration test needs broader dependency injection/reset seams, so no fake-router approximation was added. No live iOS/Android provider OAuth tested.

Integrator.assignment: Inspect final diff, task state, ownership, verification, and reviewer findings; determine safe closure/integration state.
Integrator.evidence: Source fix and 63 targeted tests/analyze/diff check pass. Reviewer has no BLOCKER/HIGH but has a material MEDIUM integration-coverage gap. No live provider/device proof. Workspace is main at 5d3ff068, origin/main at beed461f (2 commits ahead) with foreign dirty paths; no commit/push/deploy performed.

plan.completion_criteria: OAuth success callback does not replace an in-app current route or required feature-tour route; auth/root redirect still reaches home.
Cancel/resume clears only active login pending state, releases spinner, re-enables choices; stale callback/resume cannot clear a newer attempt.
Regression coverage proves Google/Naver/Kakao share required tour; only final confirmation marks first-run tour complete.
Targeted tests/analyze/diff check pass; independent review has no BLOCKER/HIGH; Integrator inspects final diff and task state.
plan.remaining: A true OAuth callback→router→required-tour integration/widget test requires introducing auth/router/Shell test seams because production routing and auth state are module globals and Shell starts concrete OS services. No fake-router approximation was added. Live iOS/Android OAuth remains unverified.

integration_remediation.requested_goal: Close the independent-review MEDIUM by proving actual OAuth callback -> production router -> Shell -> required three-page FeatureTour completion in one widget integration test.
integration_remediation.implementation_summary: Narrow test seams construct the production router with injected AuthProvider, StartupRouteGate, FeatureTourStore, and Shell startup-task opt-out; OAuthCallbackHandler receives only a callback-session adapter. Production defaults remain appRouter = createAppRouter(). The handler preserves the callback response provider token for the Naver capture path and no production scheduling workaround remains.
